integrity: All proof and verification files embedded. Characteristic identities are exact symbolic calculations; bounded enumeration checks support but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Strict deterministic exact-two response on cubic prisms/Möbius ladders only; no dynamics, welfare, arbitrary graphs, or correspondence of individual equilibria. Equivalent earlier formulations in unindexed literature remain possible.
title: Boundary-twist cancellation for exact-two public-goods equilibria on Möbius ladders
